highlights_led_by_exploit_ready_vulns: European Commission HR hit by cyber attack and VMware patches vCenter zero-day exploited in attacks since September. Treat newly published PoCs and early exploitation signals as immediate patch/mitigation triggers for internet-facing and fleet-wide infrastructure.
endpoint_posture_under_pressure: A single pull request could have handed attackers the keys to Microsoft’s software supply chain. Tighten EDR coverage, block known IoCs where available, and validate software supply-chain integrity in build and CI/CD.
identity_and_edge_access_risks: Ukrainian authorities arrest four suspects in international ransomware operation. Prioritize MFA enforcement, phishing-resistant authentication, and reduce management-plane exposure for edge services and remote access.
